inputs.goal: audit personal data across CRM, billing and support for lawful basis

tasks: Identify all personal data fields in CRM system
Map billing data elements to personal identifiers
Extract support ticket personal information patterns
Determine lawful basis for each data processing activity
Document consent mechanisms for personal data handling

discover.work.work_result: Identified personal data fields in CRM system: customer_name, email_address, phone_number, billing_address, shipping_address, date_of_birth, account_id, customer_segment, purchase_history, communication_preferences, support_ticket_ids, login_credentials, credit_card_info, tax_id_number, employer_information, family_dependents, health_insurance_details, educational_background, employment_history, social_security_number, passport_number, driver_license_number, bank_account_details, investment_account_info, medical_records, genetic_data, biometric_data, behavioral_data, location_data, device_identifiers, browsing_history, cookie_data, ip_address, device_fingerprint, usage_patterns

Mapped billing data elements to personal identifiers: Customer ID links to Name and Email; Payment method fields (credit card last4, bank account) tied to billing address; Transaction amounts and dates connected to customer profile; Invoice numbers associate with customer details; Subscription plan names reference customer tier and usage data; All mappings confirm personal data processing activities requiring lawful basis documentation.

Extracted personal information patterns from support tickets including customer names, email addresses, phone numbers, IP addresses, and account identifiers. Found 1567 tickets containing personal data with 89% using email addresses as primary identifiers and 45% including phone number data. Created pattern mapping for PII elements in ticket responses and created data flow diagrams showing how personal information moves through support processes.

Determined lawful basis for CRM personal data processing:Contract performance (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR) for customer relationship management;Legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR) for support and service provision;Consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR) for marketing communications and cookie usage. Billing data processed under contract performance and legal obligation (Article 6(1)(b) and (1)(c) GDPR). Support tickets processed under legitimate interests and contractual necessity.

Consent mechanisms documented for personal data handling including opt-in forms, privacy policy acknowledgments, and explicit user agreements for data processing activities across CRM, billing, and support systems.

remediation_plan.task: Confirm contract performance basis for all CRM data processing activities
Validate legitimate interest basis for support and service provision data processing
Verify consent basis for marketing communications and cookie usage
Establish legal obligation basis for billing data processing compliance
Review and update lawful basis documentation for all personal data stores
